findings.title: Generic API Key/Password
findings.pci_dss: Req 8.3.2 - Strong cryptography for credential management
findings.description: Possible hardcoded credential or API key.
findings.business_impact: Unauthorized service access, data breach, and regulatory violation. Credentials in VCS history persist even after removal from HEAD. Rotation is mandatory and git history must be purged.
remediation: Remove all hardcoded credentials immediately.
Store secrets in environment variables or a secrets manager (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager).
Rotate any exposed credentials immediately.
Scan git history (truffleHog, gitleaks) and revoke previously committed secrets.
Add pre-commit hooks (detect-secrets) to prevent future leakage.

findings.title: SQL Injection
findings.snippet: cur.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + user + "'")
findings.soc2: CC6.1 Logical and Physical Access Controls
findings.business_impact: Complete database compromise, data exfiltration, authentication bypass.
remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements exclusively.
Apply an ORM with query parameter binding.
Validate and sanitize all user-supplied input server-side.
Implement a WAF rule to detect common SQL injection patterns.
Apply principle of least privilege on database accounts.
